054/**
055 * Provides methods to load a constraint set expressed in any supported
056 * Metaschema format.
057 * <p>
058 * Loaded constraint instances are cached to avoid the need to load them for
059 * every use. Any constraint set imported is also loaded and cached
060 * automatically.
061 */
062public class BindingConstraintLoader
063    extends AbstractLoader<List<IConstraintSet>>
064    implements IConstraintLoader {
065
066  @NonNull
067  private final IBoundLoader loader;
068
069  /**
070   * Construct a new loader.
071   *
072   * @param bindingContext
073   *          the Metaschema binding information used to parse constraint data
074   */
075  public BindingConstraintLoader(@NonNull IBindingContext bindingContext) {
076    this.loader = bindingContext.newBoundLoader();
077    // this.loader.enableFeature(DeserializationFeature.DESERIALIZE_VALIDATE_CONSTRAINTS);
078  }
079
080  @Override
081  protected List<IConstraintSet> parseResource(@NonNull URI resource, @NonNull Deque<URI> visitedResources)
082      throws IOException {
083    StaticContext.Builder builder = StaticContext.builder()
084        .baseUri(resource);
085    builder.useWildcardWhenNamespaceNotDefaulted(true);
086
087    // parse this set of constraints
088    Object constraintsDocument = loader.load(resource);
089
090    List<IConstraintSet> retval;
091    if (constraintsDocument instanceof MetaschemaModuleConstraints) {
092      MetaschemaModuleConstraints obj = (MetaschemaModuleConstraints) constraintsDocument;
093
094      // now check if this constraint set imports other constraint sets
095      List<MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Import> imports = CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getImports());
096
097      // handle imports
098      @NonNull
099      Set<IConstraintSet> importedConstraints;
100      if (imports.isEmpty()) {
101        importedConstraints = CollectionUtil.emptySet();
102      } else {
103        try {
104          importedConstraints = new LinkedHashSet<>();
105          for (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Import imported : imports) {
106            URI importedResource = imported.getHref();
107            importedResource = ObjectUtils.notNull(resource.resolve(importedResource));
108            importedConstraints.addAll(loadInternal(importedResource, visitedResources));
109          }
110        } catch (MetaschemaException ex) {
111          throw new IOException(ex);
112        }
113      }
114
115      // handle namespace to prefix bindings
116      CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getNamespaceBindings()).stream()
117          .forEach(binding -> builder.namespace(
118              ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getPrefix()),
119              ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getUri())));
120      ISource source = ISource.externalSource(resource);
121
122      // create the constraint set
123      retval = CollectionUtil.singletonList(new ScopedConstraintSet(
124          source,
125          parseScopedConstraints(obj, source),
126          new LinkedHashSet<>(importedConstraints)));
127    } else if (constraintsDocument instanceof MetaschemaMetaConstraints) {
128      MetaschemaMetaConstraints obj = (MetaschemaMetaConstraints) constraintsDocument;
129
130      // now check if this constraint set imports other constraint sets
131      List<MetaschemaMetaConstraints.Import> imports = CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getImports());
132
133      List<IConstraintSet> importedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
134      if (!imports.isEmpty()) {
135        try {
136          for (MetaschemaMetaConstraints.Import imported : imports) {
137            URI importedResource = imported.getHref();
138            importedResource = ObjectUtils.notNull(resource.resolve(importedResource));
139            importedConstraints.addAll(loadInternal(importedResource, visitedResources));
140          }
141        } catch (MetaschemaException ex) {
142          throw new IOException(ex);
143        }
144      }
145
146      CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getNamespaceBindings()).stream()
147          .forEach(binding -> builder.namespace(
148              ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getPrefix()),
149              ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getUri())));
150
151      ISource source = ISource.externalSource(builder.build(), false);
152
153      List<MetaConstraintSet.Context> contexts
154          = ObjectUtils.notNull(CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getContexts()).stream()
155              .map(context -> parseContext(ObjectUtils.notNull(context), null, source))
156              .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList()));
157      retval = Collections.singletonList(new MetaConstraintSet(source, importedConstraints, contexts));
158    } else {
159      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(String.format("Unsupported constraint content '%s'.", resource));
160    }
161    return retval;
162  }
163
164  /**
165   * Parse individual constraint definitions from the provided XMLBeans object.
166   *
167   * @param obj
168   *          the XMLBeans object
169   * @param source
170   *          the source of the constraint content
171   * @return the scoped constraint definitions
172   */
173  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidInstantiatingObjectsInLoops") // intentional
174  @NonNull
175  protected List<IScopedContraints> parseScopedConstraints(
176      @NonNull MetaschemaModuleConstraints obj,
177      @NonNull ISource source) {
178    List<IScopedContraints> scopedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
179
180    for (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope scope : CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(obj.getScopes())) {
181      assert scope != null;
182
183      List<ITargetedConstraints> targetedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
184      try {
185        for (IValueConstraintsBase constraintsObj : CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(scope.getConstraints())) {
186          if (constraintsObj instanceof MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Assembly) {
187            targetedConstraints.add(handleScopedAssembly(
188                (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Assembly) constraintsObj,
189                source));
190          } else if (constraintsObj instanceof MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Field) {
191            targetedConstraints.add(handleScopedField(
192                (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Field) constraintsObj,
193                source));
194          } else if (constraintsObj instanceof MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Flag) {
195            targetedConstraints.add(handleScopedFlag(
196                (MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Flag) constraintsObj,
197                source));
198          }
199        }
200      } catch (MetapathException | XmlValueNotSupportedException ex) {
201        if (ex.getCause() instanceof MetapathException) {
202          throw new MetapathException(
203              String.format("Unable to compile a Metapath in '%s'. %s",
204                  source.getSource(),
205                  ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
206              ex);
207        }
208        throw ex;
209      }
210
211      URI namespace = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(scope.getMetaschemaNamespace());
212      String shortName = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(scope.getMetaschemaShortName());
213
214      scopedConstraints.add(new DefaultScopedContraints(
215          namespace,
216          shortName,
217          CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(targetedConstraints)));
218    }
219    return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(scopedConstraints);
220  }
221
222  private static AssemblyTargetedConstraints handleScopedAssembly(
223      @NonNull MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Assembly obj,
224      @NonNull ISource source) {
225    IModelConstrained constraints = new AssemblyConstraintSet(source);
226    ConstraintBindingSupport.parse(constraints, obj, source);
227    return new AssemblyTargetedConstraints(
228        source,
229        () -> Collections.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
230            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(obj.getTarget()),
231            source.getStaticContext())),
232        constraints);
233  }
234
235  private static FieldTargetedConstraints handleScopedField(
236      @NonNull MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Field obj,
237      @NonNull ISource source) {
238    IValueConstrained constraints = new ValueConstraintSet(source);
239    ConstraintBindingSupport.parse(constraints, obj, source);
240
241    return new FieldTargetedConstraints(
242        source,
243        () -> Collections.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
244            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(obj.getTarget()),
245            source.getStaticContext())),
246        constraints);
247  }
248
249  private static FlagTargetedConstraints handleScopedFlag(
250      @NonNull MetaschemaModuleConstraints.Scope.Flag obj,
251      @NonNull ISource source) {
252    IValueConstrained constraints = new ValueConstraintSet(source);
253    ConstraintBindingSupport.parse(constraints, obj, source);
254
255    return new FlagTargetedConstraints(
256        source,
257        () -> Collections.singletonList(IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
258            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(obj.getTarget()),
259            source.getStaticContext())),
260        constraints);
261  }
262
263  private MetaConstraintSet.Context parseContext(
264      @NonNull MetapathContext contextObj,
265      @Nullable MetaConstraintSet.Context parent,
266      @NonNull ISource source) {
267
268    // generate the metapaths
269    List<IMetapathExpression> metapaths = ObjectUtils
270        .notNull(CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(contextObj.getMetapaths()).stream()
271            .map(MetaschemaMetapath::getTarget)
272            .map(metapath -> IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
273                ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(metapath),
274                source.getStaticContext())))
275        .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList());
276
277    // parse the constraints
278    AssemblyConstraints contextConstraints = contextObj.getConstraints();
279    IModelConstrained constraints = new AssemblyConstraintSet(source);
280    if (contextConstraints != null) {
281      ConstraintBindingSupport.parse(constraints, contextConstraints, source);
282    }
283
284    // create the context
285    MetaConstraintSet.Context context = new MetaConstraintSet.Context(parent, source, metapaths, constraints);
286
287    // create the child contexts
288    List<MetaConstraintSet.Context> childContexts
289        = ObjectUtils.notNull(CollectionUtil.listOrEmpty(contextObj.getContexts()).stream()
290            .map(childObj -> parseContext(ObjectUtils.notNull(childObj), context, source))
291            .collect(Collectors.toList()));
292
293    context.addAll(childContexts);
294
295    return context;
296  }
297}
